name: Are there specific non-slip flooring options recommended for accessibility in a Bay Area home?

mainEntity.name: Are there specific non-slip flooring options recommended for accessibility in a Bay Area home?

acceptedAnswer.text: For accessibility in a Bay Area home, specific non-slip flooring options provide enhanced safety. Textured porcelain or ceramic tiles with a high Coefficient of Friction (COF) are excellent choices. Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or tile (LVT) with an embossed or textured finish also offers good grip and is comfortable underfoot, which can be beneficial for individuals using mobility aids. Rubber flooring is another highly recommended option due to its superior slip resistance and cushioning properties, reducing impact if a fall occurs. These materials help create a safer bathroom environment, reducing the risk of slips and supporting independent living.
acceptedAnswer.description: For Bay Area homes requiring accessibility, textured porcelain/ceramic tiles, textured LVP/LVT, and rubber flooring are highly recommended due to their superior grip and safety features.
